verses.1: Then the LORD said to Noah, "Come into the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen that you are righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.2: Take with you seven pairs of every clean animal, the male and its mate, and a pair of every animal that is not clean, the male and its mate,
verses.3: and seven pairs of every bird of the sky, male and female, to keep each kind alive over all the earth.
verses.4: For seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will blot out every living thing I have made from the face of the ground."
verses.5: And Noah did everything the LORD commanded him.
verses.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.7: Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
verses.8: Of clean animals and animals that are not clean, and of birds and every creature that moves along the ground,
verses.9: two by two they came to Noah and entered the ark, male and female, just as God had commanded Noah.
verses.10: And after seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.11: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, all the springs of the great deep burst open and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
verses.12: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.13: On that very day Noah and his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons entered the ark,
verses.14: along with every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creature that moves along the ground according to its kind, and every bird according to its kind — every winged creature.
verses.15: Two of every kind of creature that had the breath of life came to Noah and entered the ark.
verses.16: Male and female of every living thing came in, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
verses.17: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth. As the waters rose they lifted the ark and it rose above the earth.
verses.18: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
verses.19: The waters rose so greatly on the earth that all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.
verses.20: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of fifteen cubits.
verses.21: Every living thing that moved on the earth perished — birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.
verses.22: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
verses.23: Every living thing on the face of the ground was wiped out — people, animals, crawling things, and birds of the sky. They were wiped from the earth. Only Noah remained, and those with him in the ark.
verses.24: The waters flooded the earth for 150 days.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
